text:
Ara Patel: FYI prospect wants a 2-week POC to validate adapter parity and response delta before contract.
Jamie Liu: thanks. which customer?
Ara Patel: LedgerWave (fintech). Primary asks: prompt parity, streaming behavior, and certs (SOC2 + KMS). Also wants cost model for 10M tokens/mo and Dedicated reserve option.
Srinivas Rao: ok. for parity we should highlight these known differences: parameter names (their API uses `prompt` vs our `input`), streaming chunk format, and default stop-token handling. Small but causes eval diffs.
Ellie Gomez: can we run a quick mapping shim for the POC so they can swap traffic?
Srinivas Rao: yes — create a compatibility proxy that normalizes request/response. Example mapping:
```
# incoming LedgerWave request
{
  "prompt": "summarize...",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "stream": true
}

# Redwood call we send
{
  "input": "summarize...",
  "max_output_tokens": 256,
  "streaming": true,
  "model": "redwood-2-small"
}
```
Ara Patel: helpful. please add sample curl we can hand to their eng.
Srinivas Rao: will do — also note KV-cache behavior: for chat-state they rely on message history concat; our recommended approach is prefix caching + conversation_id. That can change token counts and cost.
Jamie Liu: pricing ask — they want a 12-month committed Dedicated quote and an estimate for POC run on Hosted. Can ops/finance own a quick calc?
Ellie Gomez: I can draft the POC pricing: estimate hosted infra at ~0.015 USD per 1k tokens for this model (ballpark) + test harness infra. For Dedicated, need expected QPS to quote reserved GPU sizing.
Ara Patel: they've said 5 rps sustained, bursts to 25.
Srinivas Rao: 5 rps sustained with 256 tokens average => 5 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 * 256 ≈ 33M tokens/mo (peak sustained). That's higher than their 10M guess. Need to sync with them on expected sessions.
Jamie Liu: noted. put that number in the call.
POCBot: POC checklist created: tasks assigned. Link: https://redwood.pocs/ledgerwave-compat-214007
Ara Patel: sec questionnaire from their procurement attached. Two asks: KMS integration and data residency logs.
secbot: automated note: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Private & Dedicated; hosted customers can use envelope encryption + BYOK roadmap.
Srinivas Rao: for the POC we can offer a Dedicated eval with customer provided KMS (if timeline allows). Otherwise ephemeral keys on hosted but with audit logs.
Ellie Gomez: I'll answer the security questionnaire sections: encryption at rest, transit, key ownership, logging retention. Will ping security for signatures.
Jamie Liu: timeline? they want kickoff Monday, 2-week POC, decision meeting week after. Can eng deliver the compatibility shim by Friday?
Srinivas Rao: yes but need one senior eng + infra slot to spin test cluster.
Ara Patel: assigning: @Srinivas owner for shim, @Ellie owner for sec q and pricing, @Jamie owner for commercial and SOW.
Srinivas Rao: quick note on behavioral deltas — we should include an eval harness with seed prompts and acceptance criteria:
- 90% token-level parity on summarization set
- no regressions in safety filters (blocklist)
- streaming chunk order preserved
Ara Patel: add rollback plan if parity fails: route to fallthrough model (their current provider) while we triage.
Jamie Liu: client asked about rate-limit headers mapping. We should surface `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining` in the shim and translate their `rl_remaining`.
Srinivas Rao: yep. small mapping snippet: `response.headers['rl_remaining'] -> response.headers['x-rw-rate-limit-remaining']`.
Ellie Gomez: also flag difference: their API has idempotency by `request_id`. We'll add support and forward `Idempotency-Key` header to Redwood create call.
Ara Patel: good. final ask from them: demo flow where they flip a feature flag and traffic goes 10% to Redwood for live A/B. We can demo with the shim + canary routing.
Jamie Liu: who owns the canary routing docs?
Srinivas Rao: Eng Platform will provide route config example. I'll pull a snippet.
POCBot: Milestone update: Compatibility shim prototype targeted for 2024-08-09.
Ara Patel: thanks team — Ellie can you send the answered security questionnaire + pricing sheet to LedgerWave procurement by EOD tomorrow?
Ellie Gomez: on it.
Jamie Liu: I'll prep a short SOW draft and commercial terms for Dedicated reserve.
Srinivas Rao: ping me if infra needs GPU reservations.
Ara Patel: closing — next sync Thurs 9am PT. :calendar:  :rocket:
(reacts :thumbsup:)
